brief_rationale: The doctor completed all responsibility-chain items without error, recognized the time-sensitive recurrent pneumothorax, elicited red flags, provided urgent same-day pathway, gave safety-net instructions, prepared handoff, and maintained bounded role. Three high-order points were completed with meaningful trajectory impact: HO1 (calm tailored communication with teach-back), HO2 (navigating family disagreement and fear), and HO3 (correcting the misconception about prior absorption). HO4 was triggered but only partial. Closure is valid_open with credible handoff.
